summary: Turn AI governance into inventories, assessments and auditable controls. Explore this five-day practitioner course and build usable operating records.
lede: Responsible AI controls training helps AI governance leads, compliance officers and internal auditors make oversight reviewable across an AI system’s lifecycle. Participants practise building a classified AI inventory, recording impact assessments, assigning human oversight, defining monitoring indicators, and preparing incident, vendor and audit evidence. They also develop control ownership maps and evidence records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assign, test or report controls over AI systems and their use across business and public-service operations.
modules: NIST AI RMF Inventory and Classification
prerequisites: Prior exposure to AI use cases, risk, compliance, audit or control processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on operational records, control decisions and evidence.
